title: Talking to a file
followUps: Make it light, and check the contrast.

beats.title: What's in it
beats.says: Its layers, variables and fonts, read from the file.

beats.title: Make it light
beats.says: The Light mode set, every text checked against WCAG AA, saved as a new file.

beats.title: Turn it into code
beats.says: The file's exact values read, and the model writes the code.

outcome.summary: What the file is, a light version of it saved beside it, and its code.
